landing.title: Haɗa wadatar kayan gona da ainihin buƙata
landing.subtitle: Nemi manoman da aka tantance, daidaita buƙata da wadata, sannan ku yanke shawarar kasuwanci mafi kyau ta hanyar amfani da AI mai bayyana dalilai.
landing.howItWorksSub: Kasuwar B2B ta noma wacce aka gina don sauƙaƙe ma'amaloli.
landing.explainableAiSub: AgroLink tana amfani da ingantaccen tsarin lissafi tare da AI don bayyana muku ainihin dalilin da ya sa wani manomi ya dace da buƙatarku.
landing.trustRatingsSub: Dukkan ɓangarorin biyu suna ba da kima bayan kowane ciniki, wanda ke gina amana don haɓaka daidaituwa a gaba.
landing.logisticsSub: Shirye-shiryen sufuri da haɗa motocin kaya. Yana nan tafe nan ba da jimawa ba don sauƙaƙe kai kayan gona ko'ina a Najeriya.
landing.farmersText: Sami damar tuntuɓar manyan masu saya kai-tsaye, sami farashi mai kyau, kuma ku gina sunan ku da aka tantance.
landing.buyersText: Sayi kaya daga gonakin da aka tantance, sarrafa inganci, kuma ku tsara lokutan da suka dace da ku.
